検出した物体中心からy–x（軌跡）、x–t、y–tを表示します。未校正ならpx、: View the detected centers in y–x (trajectory), x–t and y–t graphs. Coordinates are in pixels until you calibrate length and axes, then in meters. The origin and axes match the coordinate table. Unmarked, missing, uncertain and skipped frames are omitted.
初期表示はx・yを全ての検出点に合わせた共通の範囲にします。各軸の±ボタンで横軸: Initially, all three graphs use a common x and y range that includes every detected point. Zoom each plotted axis independently with its ± controls; the aspect ratio is not locked. Pinch along an axis to zoom, or drag to pan. The mouse wheel zooms both axes over the plot and only one axis over its tick labels. Matching axes stay in sync across graphs. Use Fit all to reset the view. Keyboard shortcuts: +/− to zoom, arrow keys to pan, 0 to reset.
各グラフで0〜3次の多項式またはsin（正弦波）をフィットし、曲線と式を表示しま: Fit a polynomial of degree 0–3 or a sine curve to each graph, and display the fitted curve and equation. Linear, quadratic and cubic fits need at least 2, 3 and 4 points with distinct horizontal values. A sine fit needs at least 6 such points; it estimates amplitude, period, phase and offset. Angles in the sine equation use radians. The search extends to four times the visible horizontal span; the shortest period for evenly spaced data is twice the frame interval. A short or sparse oscillation may not have a unique period. Equations show six significant digits, while calculations use unrounded coordinates. On small screens, switch graphs with the tabs.
点A・点Bを選び、画像上の距離が分かる2点をタップ・ドラッグで合わせます。実際の: Choose A and B, then tap or drag them onto two points of known distance in the image. Enter the actual length in meters and choose whether the line defines the x or y axis. Pinch, scroll or use ± to zoom.

Zero is horizontal, and positive angles turn counterclockwise. You can also adjust axis length. The two axes are perpendicular and use the same scale. Positive x points right and positive y points up; for a vertical x axis, positive x points up.
